<?php
/**
 * SecureDBDriver - Database connection driver with encryption and rate limiting
 * Uses AES-256-GCM for query encryption in transit to database proxy
 */

class RateLimiter {
    private $maxAttempts;
    private $windowSeconds;
    private $attempts = [];

    public function __construct(int $maxAttempts = 100, int $windowSeconds = 60) {
        $this->maxAttempts = $maxAttempts;
        $this->windowSeconds = $windowSeconds;
    }

    public function isAllowed(string $clientId): bool {
        $now = time();
        $this->attempts[$clientId] = array_filter(
            $this->attempts[$clientId] ?? [],
            fn($t) => ($now - $t) < $this->windowSeconds
        );
        if (count($this->attempts[$clientId]) >= $this->maxAttempts) {
            return false;
        }
        $this->attempts[$clientId][] = $now;
        return true;
    }
}

class CryptoContext {
    private $masterKey;
    private $derivedKey;
    private $nonce;
    private $counter;

    public function __construct(string $masterKey) {
        $this->masterKey = $masterKey;
        $this->counter = 0;
        $this->rotateKey();
    }

    public function rotateKey(): void {
        $salt = random_bytes(16);
        $this->derivedKey = hash_hkdf('sha256', $this->masterKey, 32, 'db-driver-v2', $salt);
        $this->nonce = $this->generateNonce();
        $this->counter = 0;
    }

    private function generateNonce(): string {
        return random_bytes(12);
    }

    public function encrypt(string $plaintext): array {
        $iv = $this->getCurrentIV();
        $ciphertext = openssl_encrypt(
            $plaintext,
            'aes-256-gcm',
            $this->derivedKey,
            OPENSSL_RAW_DATA,
            $iv,
            $tag,
            '',
            16
        );
        $this->counter++;
        return ['ct' => $ciphertext, 'iv' => $iv, 'tag' => $tag];
    }

    private function getCurrentIV(): string {
        // XOR counter into the last 4 bytes of nonce for uniqueness
        $iv = $this->nonce;
        $counterBytes = pack('N', $this->counter);
        $ivBytes = substr($iv, 0, 8) . (substr($iv, 8, 4) ^ $counterBytes);
        return $ivBytes;
    }

    public function getCounter(): int {
        return $this->counter;
    }
}

class SecureDBDriver {
    private $cryptoCtx;
    private $rateLimiter;
    private $maxRetries;
    private $connectionPool;
    private $queryLog = [];

    public function __construct(string $masterKey, int $maxRetries = 3) {
        $this->cryptoCtx = new CryptoContext($masterKey);
        $this->rateLimiter = new RateLimiter(100, 60);
        $this->maxRetries = $maxRetries;
        $this->connectionPool = [];
    }

    public function executeQuery(string $clientId, string $query, array $params = []): array {
        if (!$this->rateLimiter->isAllowed($clientId)) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Rate limit exceeded for client: ' . $clientId);
        }

        $preparedQuery = $this->prepareQuery($query, $params);
        return $this->executeWithRetry($clientId, $preparedQuery);
    }

    /**
     * Safely bind parameters into the query. Placeholders MUST use the form
     * :name where name is [A-Za-z0-9_]. Values are strictly validated and
     * properly quoted. Longest placeholder names are matched first to avoid
     * prefix-collision substitution bugs.
     */
    private function prepareQuery(string $query, array $params): string {
        // Validate that every placeholder present in the query has a binding
        // and that every binding corresponds to a real placeholder.
        preg_match_all('/:([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)/', $query, $matches);
        $placeholdersInQuery = array_unique($matches[1]);

        foreach ($placeholdersInQuery as $name) {
            if (!array_key_exists($name, $params)) {
                throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Missing bound parameter: ' . $name);
            }
        }

        // Sort keys by length (desc) so ':identity' is replaced before ':id'.
        $keys = array_keys($params);
        usort($keys, fn($a, $b) => strlen((string)$b) <=> strlen((string)$a));

        $prepared = $query;
        foreach ($keys as $key) {
            if (!preg_match('/^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$/', (string)$key)) {
                throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Invalid parameter name: ' . $key);
            }
            $escaped = $this->escapeValue($params[$key]);
            // Use a word-boundary anchored replacement to avoid partial matches.
            $prepared = preg_replace(
                '/:' . preg_quote((string)$key, '/') . '\\b/',
                // Escape backreference tokens ($, \\) in replacement string.
                preg_replace('/[\\\\$]/', '\\\\$0', $escaped),
                $prepared
            );
        }
        return $prepared;
    }

    private function escapeValue($value): string {
        if (is_null($value)) return 'NULL';
        if (is_bool($value)) return $value ? '1' : '0';
        if (is_int($value)) return (string)$value;
        if (is_float($value)) return (string)$value;
        if (!is_string($value)) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Unsupported parameter type for binding');
        }
        // Reject NUL bytes which can truncate/confuse downstream parsers.
        if (strpos($value, "\0") !== false) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('NUL byte not allowed in parameter value');
        }
        // Proper SQL string escaping: escape backslash and single quote.
        // addslashes() is insufficient/unsafe for SQL; use explicit escaping.
        $escaped = str_replace(
            ['\\', "'"],
            ['\\\\', "''"],
            $value
        );
        return "'" . $escaped . "'";
    }

    private function executeWithRetry(string $clientId, string $query): array {
        $lastException = null;
        $attempt = 0;

        while ($attempt < $this->maxRetries) {
            try {
                $encrypted = $this->cryptoCtx->encrypt($query);
                $result = $this->sendToProxy($encrypted);
                $this->logQuery($clientId, $query, true, $attempt);
                return $result;
            } catch (\RuntimeException $e) {
                $lastException = $e;
                $attempt++;
                if ($this->isTransientError($e)) {
                    // On transient failure, rotate key for fresh cryptographic state
                    $this->resetCryptoForRetry();
                    usleep(min(100000 * pow(2, $attempt), 2000000));
                } else {
                    break;
                }
            }
        }

        $this->logQuery($clientId, $query, false, $attempt);
        throw $lastException ?? new \RuntimeException('Query failed after retries');
    }

    private function resetCryptoForRetry(): void {
        // Full key rotation to ensure fresh cryptographic material on retry
        // This prevents any possibility of IV/key reuse across attempts
        $this->cryptoCtx->rotateKey();
    }

    private function isTransientError(\RuntimeException $e): bool {
        $transientCodes = [110, 111, 104]; // Connection timed out, refused, reset
        return in_array($e->getCode(), $transientCodes);
    }

    private function sendToProxy(array $encrypted): array {
        // Simulate sending encrypted query to database proxy
        $socket = $this->getConnection();
        $payload = json_encode($encrypted);
        // In production, this sends over TLS socket
        if (!$socket) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Connection failed', 111);
        }
        return ['status' => 'ok', 'rows' => []];
    }

    private function getConnection() {
        // Connection pool management
        return true; // Simplified
    }

    private function logQuery(string $clientId, string $query, bool $success, int $attempts): void {
        $this->queryLog[] = [
            'client' => hash('sha256', $clientId),
            'query_hash' => hash('sha256', $query),
            'success' => $success,
            'attempts' => $attempts,
            'timestamp' => microtime(true)
        ];
    }

    public function getStats(): array {
        return [
            'total_queries' => count($this->queryLog),
            'failed_queries' => count(array_filter($this->queryLog, fn($l) => !$l['success'])),
            'crypto_counter' => $this->cryptoCtx->getCounter()
        ];
    }
}
